msg: Being alert and focused is obviously essential make sure you're not taking too much time deciding as it seems a game based mostly on luck. Saying that I found that the bigger gnomes were more lucrative and for a while matching the higher number cards with the bigger gnomes worked for me in getting higher numbers. Mostly I found the purple and blue more successfull but patterns seemed to change after a while so keep switching it up. Even if you're not sure of a pattern or strategy try stick to one for a while, it keeps you more engaged.
